steps.name: root_writes_admission
steps.command: Root copies root-admission.template.json to a root-owned receipt, changes status to admitted, and binds the exact review SHA only after same-panel 1585/1902 selection.

steps.name: create_admitted_binding
steps.command: PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 taskset -c 0,2 /home/m0hawk/Documents/Sepalith/.venv-sft/bin/python source/prepare_binding.py --registry candidates.json --candidate 1585 --review-output root-binding-review.final.json --root-admission /ABSOLUTE/ROOT/ADMISSION.json --binding-output merge.binding.json

steps.name: cpu_merge_candidate
steps.command: ionice -c3 nice -n10 taskset -c 0,2 env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 /home/m0hawk/Documents/Sepalith/.venv-sft/bin/python source/merge_cloud_cpt_parent.py --binding merge.binding.json

notes: Do not use the template admission as authorization.
The 1902 registry entry is intentionally non-runnable until an immutable local readback and root receipt exist.
The merge produces an unselected candidate; it does not authorize training, evaluation, promotion, or final access.
